description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Imperial Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Buff Earth 30% (15s)], [Buff Wind 30% (15s)], [Buff Dark 30% (15s)] and [Resist Break Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Imperial Mode
description.text: Earth, Wind and Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth, Wind and Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Buff Earth 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Wind 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Dark 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Resist Break Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Earth/Wind/Dark Resist Break after using two Earth, Wind or Dark abilities if the triggering ability deals Earth/Wind/Dark damage
